text:
emily: Quick PSA: our Kotlin sample app hit a weird hang where streaming calls stall then 504 after a token refresh. Repro on emulator + Pixel 7 on Android 15.

raj: can you share the code for how you refresh tokens? Interceptor or Authenticator?

emily: Interceptor. It calls tokenService.refresh().execute() (Retrofit sync) while holding a tokenLock, then retries using chain.proceed().

tom_b: calling Retrofit.execute() inside an interceptor is dangerous if it uses the same OkHttpClient. It can consume dispatcher threads and deadlock.

nina: also watch Retrofit CallAdapter/Coroutine adapters. If your interceptor blocks a dispatcher thread and the adapter tries to resume on that thread, you can get a livelock.

emily: stack traces showed many threads in WAITING and Http2 stream resets. We also saw cancelled streams when refresh started.

sdk-bot: checklist: 1) don't use same client for token endpoint from interceptor; 2) prefer OkHttp Authenticator for 401 flows when possible; 3) if you must refresh in interceptor, do it on a separate Executor/Client and avoid blocking network dispatcher threads.

raj: for Kotlin coroutines we do this pattern: perform a non-blocking refresh via a separate refreshClient and a Mutex/Deferred singleflight so only one refresh happens. But here's an alternative using Authenticator + executor I like:
```kotlin
class TokenAuthenticator(private val refreshClient: OkHttpClient, private val executor: Executor) : Authenticator {
  override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
    // run blocking refresh off the network dispatcher
    val future = CompletableFuture.supplyAsync({ doRefreshWithRefreshClient() }, executor)
    val token = try { future.get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS) } catch (e: Exception) { return null }
    return response.request.newBuilder()
      .header("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
      .build()
  }
}
```

emily: we switched to an Authenticator that calls refreshClient and an executor fixed our hang. Also set callTimeout/readTimeout lower for streaming and set retryOnConnectionFailure=false for the streaming route.

tom_b: one caveat: Authenticator is invoked on the network thread too, so STILL don't call the same client. RefreshClient must not have the auth interceptor.

nina: add README blurb: "Avoid calling the primary OkHttp client from inside interceptors or authenticators. Use a separate client + executor or a singleflight dedupe. On Android 15 HTTP/2 prioritization changes can make connection reuse surface as 504s instead of slower responses."

emily: opened PR with sample changes: swap to Authenticator + refreshClient, add integration test that spawns 30 parallel streams and toggles the token expiry. CI: please run emulator integ.

ci-bot: build/24150 started for emily/authenticator-refresh-sample; running unit + integration tests.

emily: thanks! pinging when PR ready for review. :sparkles:
